Kh.bar_b_note: The fox model's fur, scarf and big-eared silhouette are close to Palworld creature finish, but on a flat grey stage with no sky, fog or time-of-day grade there is no Valheim-class light, and B's faint frames show the fox sitting upright and alert, so the faint does not read.

Zp.bar_b_note: The shaggy white goat with long swept horns has naturalistic fleece at Stormcapra-bar level, but the neutral stage gives no atmosphere, and A's faint end is an upright sit facing camera rather than a collapse.

Jp.bar_b_note: The meadow, tree line and snowy range are pleasant, but the lone wall panel next to a flat-shaded grey low-poly boulder under flat noon light reads as a placement test, not a lived-in Palworld base under Valheim light.

Kp.bar_b_note: The Stormcapra ram's fleece, dark legs, curled horns and blue accent match the owner's bar, but the stage has no light or atmosphere, and B's faint rolls the ram belly-up with legs splayed and the body lifted, which hurts the finish.

Yu.bar_b_note: The violet-black Tanglevolt wolf is at Palworld creature finish and B's prone faint is grounded, but a neutral stage cannot carry Valheim-class sky, fog or grade.

Tg.bar_b_note: The snow leopard's spotted grey coat and long tail are naturalistic and on-bar, but there is no world light on the stage, and A's hit react barely moves while its faint end is an upright sit.

Xp.bar_b_note: These frames look the same as Zp: good fleece and horn detail, but no atmosphere on the stage, and A's faint end is an upright sit rather than a collapse.

Qg.bar_b_note: The Stormcapra model meets the bar, but the stage has no Valheim-class light, and in B's faint end the belly-up ram hangs above its own shadow.

Lp.bar_b_note: B's coiled, fanged, mottled serpent sits on the ground like a real creature, but A's faint flips the snake into the air with its shadow far below, and the stage has no light or atmosphere either way.

Yk.bar_b_note: The white-haired grandpa in a green vest and scarf has a warm Meadows palette and readable eyes, but he is shown on a black void with no world light, and his rounded cartoon face is softer than the naturalistic creature bar.

top_changes.change: Rebuild the faint pose for every creature as one grounded collapse onto the side or belly, with the body touching the stage and its contact shadow. Remove the belly-up rolls that lift the body (Yu A, Qg B, Kp B, Lp A) and the upright sits that do not read as a faint (Kh B, Zp/Xp A, Tg A). Give the hit react visible motion where it is missing (Tg A, Lp, Qg B).

Base the homestead wall on Jp A's timber frame, diagonal brace, stone footing and cap. Give it real thickness, use darker weathered daub instead of the blown-out cream infill, darken the cap edge, and snap it to neighbouring wall or post pieces so it reads as part of a building, not a lone panel.
Replace the flat-shaded grey low-poly boulder beside the homestead wall with a rock asset from the same family as the meadow props.
